description: An organization's attestation that a person is or was employed by it. Lives in the organization's PDS; the organization is whoever owns the repository. The organization attests employment at the entity, not a job title. The optional title and start-date snapshots let a consumer notice when the referenced position was edited afterwards: a mismatch makes the attestation stale, never void. Never pins the free-text company name, which can change in a rebrand without affecting the attestation.

main.description: Record representing an organization's attestation that a person is or was employed at its entity. Deleting the record is a revocation. Updating status from current to past with an end date is offboarding, which keeps the history.

subject.description: DID of the employee whose employment is being attested.

position.description: StrongRef to the id.sifa.profile.position record being attested. It must belong to subject. Resolve by AT-URI: the CID is the version the organization saw and must not be used as a join key, because the subject editing the position changes its CID. Omit it to attest employment at the entity as a whole, which then matches every position of the subject at that entity with an overlapping period.

status.description: Whether the employment is current or past.

source.description: How the attestation was written. Absent means an account holder confirmed it by hand.

title.description: Optional job title snapshot from the position at attestation time. If the position's title later differs, the attestation is stale until the organization re-attests.

startedAt.description: Optional start date snapshot in YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD format, mirroring the position lexicon's freeform date shape. Compared at month precision; a later difference makes the attestation stale.

entityRef.description: Portable entity identifier (Wikidata Q-ID URI, ROR URI, or LEI URI) of the employing legal entity. Omit it when the organization account itself is the anchor. Never the free-text company name.

companyDid.description: Deprecated. The attesting organization is the repository owner, so this field carries no information; readers ignore it. Kept so existing schema readers do not break.

endedAt.description: End date in YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD format. Required context when status is past.

comment.description: Optional brief comment from the organization.

labels.description: Self-label values for this attestation record.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this attestation was created.
